name: SAB’s
heroTitle: A little Spain in the Cotswolds.

strapline: Eat. Drink. Stay for the music.
shortWelcome: SAB’s is an informal Spanish wine bar where freshly prepared tapas, carefully chosen bottles and live flamenco share the same small stage.
primaryMessage: Wine from the bodegas. Tapas from an Andalusian kitchen.
aboutBannerLead: A relaxed wine bar built around the things Spain does best: food, wine and music.

aboutLead: SAB’s brings together authentic tapas, Spanish wine and live flamenco in Mickleton.
aboutBody: The wines are specially selected from Spanish bodegas by the owner, while the tapas are prepared freshly by an Andalusian chef. From 9pm, the focus shifts to the stage for live flamenco.
tapasBannerLead: Authentic Spanish plates prepared fresh in the kitchen.
wineBannerLead: Bottles personally selected from producers across Spain.
